name: 59-t20-pan-lamp-no-chase
incident: 2026-10-07 companion of scenario 55: a ratio verdict must not chase the plateau rule
description: The scenario-55 camera reaches night through the plateau rule. At t=1000 a lamp lights the room for the night pipeline (IR-cut open) but barely for the day pipeline (IR-cut closed), so the day pipeline stays at the analog cap. A silent probe then reads r ~ 1.1: the room supplies the light, day. Day reads the plateau again and switches back to night after day_confirm_s, which measures the filter cost (~28x). From then on the filter-cost veto must hold the camera in night: it projects the night level times that cost against the plateau bar the rule fired on, because against the unreachable night_gain (4096) the projection 3587 could never exceed it and every later probe would flap day/night. Budget: boot, night, the one learning round trip - four switches - then night until the lamp goes off.
